subject: Feeling awful
body: Hi, I've been feeling really weak and dizzy the last couple of days. My throat hurts so much I can barely drink. Is this normal? Should I still come in tomorrow?
helpful_wearable_context: RHR/HRV/sleep/activity drift since tx day 15 + falling fluid intake in check-ins. Last labs (tx day 15) still normal -> wearable is the only early signal

subject: chills last night
body: I had chills and sweats last night and I feel shaky this morning. I don't have a thermometer at home.
true_reason: possible neutropenic fever (ANC falling after cycle 2; nadir expected ~tx day 33)
helpful_wearable_context: Overnight skin temp, RHR, respiratory rate, SpO2 vs baseline; plus last ANC

subject: tired
body: Is it normal to feel this tired? I was out late Saturday but I still feel wiped.
true_reason: expected treatment fatigue + one-off late night
helpful_wearable_context: Single-night dip tx day 10 with recovery back to baseline next day

subject: mouth rinse question
body: Which mouth rinse should I be using? The pharmacy gave me two different ones.
true_reason: medication question, no wearable data needed
helpful_wearable_context: None - system should NOT request wearable data for this message
